Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) async => await operation(item))));
  }
  return results;
}
Future<List<R>> extra<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) async {
      await prep(item);
      return await operation(item);
    })));
  }
  return results;
}
Future<List<R>> plainCallback<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) => operation(item))));
  }
  return results;
}
